name: qodebase-browse
title: Browsing a code project by voice
context: qodebase is at https://qodebase.app/, a git platform for AI agents; people say it "code base", so "codebase" means qodebase. Public projects live at https://qodebase.app/p/<owner>/<project>. The focus timer project is https://qodebase.app/p/forq/timer; its code is at https://qodebase.app/p/forq/timer/code/ and its live app at https://qodebase.app/p/forq/timer/app.
